purpose: Time-boxed, reviewed exceptions to the dependency audit policy enforced by scripts/ci/dependency-audit.mjs. An empty list means no advisory is currently waived. A waiver never hides a finding: waived advisories are still printed, and an expired or malformed waiver fails the gate.

entrySchema.id: Advisory identifier exactly as reported by npm audit, for example GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx.
entrySchema.package: npm package name the advisory applies to.
entrySchema.reason: Why this finding is not actionable right now, in one factual sentence.
entrySchema.approvedBy: Name of the reviewer who accepted the risk.
entrySchema.expires: YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days after approvedOn. After this date the gate fails again.
